findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice mcqs for Chapter 21 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Chemistry Board shape (4 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 112 questions numbered 1-112; by section: u-introduction-halothane-classification 17, 21.1 12, 21.2 8, 21.3 5, 21.3.1 26, 21.3.2 12, 21.4 21, 21.5 4, 21.5.1 7. Covers the introduction and classification, preparation (21.1), reactivity and C-X bond energies (21.2), SN/E reactions, SN2, SN1, carbocation stability, E2 and E1 (21.3), reactions with NaOH, KCN, NH₃ and aqueous AgNO₃ (21.4), halogenoarenes and their lower reactivity (21.5) in order. Small numericals (bond-energy differences, rate-law changes and rates) were recomputed in Python; none repeats the chapter exercise. Book corrections followed: algae emit mainly bromomethane (not bromoethane), CFCs replaced by HFCs (Freons are CFCs), quaternary salt [(C₂H₅)₄N]⁺Br⁻ named N,N,N-triethylethanaminium bromide.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
